name: The Karl Stefanovic Show

name: Topher Field / Topher Field Podcast
description: Australian political commentator publishing video, interviews and podcast conversations. His interview archive includes John Ruddick, George Christensen and Craig Kelly.
notes: Field describes his work as libertarian political commentary. His current website promotes The Oddcast with Carly Soderstrom. The separate Topher Field Podcast interview feed checked ends in July 2024, so this entry does not claim that interview series is currently publishing or taking guests. The dated John Ruddick example opens the archive feed. No current Redland election coverage verified.
